title: Marina Bay Sands — Overview and history
body: Public edition. Public records, fact-checked reference. Marina Bay Sands is an integrated resort in Singapore, opened on April 27, 2010, by Las Vegas Sands. Its three towers are topped by the SkyPark, home to the famous 150-meter infinity pool, observation deck, and gardens. The resort holds about 2,561 rooms, the ArtScience Museum, the Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands, and two theaters, and is a defining feature of Singapore's skyline.
